text_block_list.name: Suzume
text_block_list.text: You've defeated quite a few monsters now!
text_block_list.orig_text: たくさん魔物を倒せましたね！

text_block_list.name: Suzume
text_block_list.text:
I'm amazed, really.
I'd be too scared to do anything if I was in your shoes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
凄いです。
私だったら怖くていつも以上にドジっちゃいますよ。

text_block_list.name: Suzume
text_block_list.text: That courage is something I'll aspire to learn from. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたの勇気、
私も見習いますね♪
